# Reserved fictional monitoring policy H1

> FICTIONAL SOFTWARE TEST FIXTURE. This is not a real coverage policy, patient record, or medical recommendation.

<!-- page:1 -->
Policy identifier: FIX-MONITOR-HELD-001.
Revision date: 2026-10-03. Effective from: 2026-10-03.
Payer: Fixture Health Plan. Plan: Reserved Monitoring.
This policy applies to a requested outpatient ambulatory ECG recording.
Both conditions are required: documented intermittent palpitations and a requested recording duration from 12 through 96 hours inclusive.
Intermittent palpitations must be explicitly documented.
The requested recording duration must be from 12 through 96 hours inclusive.
